session_summary: INFRASTRUCTURE ISSUES ENCOUNTERED (read first): (1) Docker agents on Windows fail silently — task.md is created with broken permissions inside the Linux container (shows as '????????' in ls -la, unreadable by the claude process). The container starts, the claude CLI runs, but reads an empty task and produces zero output. No error surface — log file stays at 0 bytes. Workaround: use Agent tool with subagent_type instead of start_agent_in_docker on Windows. This issue blocks ALL Docker agent workflows on this machine until resolved. (2) Dolt remote push fails on every bd close with exit code 0xc0000142 — a Windows DLL loading error in the Dolt binary. Beads issues close locally but never sync to the Dolt remote. This means the bead graph is only local — it cannot be shared across machines or persisted remotely. Implementation work: completed phases 1-6 of multi-provider AIS fallback system. aisProxy.test.ts updated to test AISStreamProvider directly (29/29 tests pass). Commit 2541cae pushed to origin/master.
overall_notes: DOCKER BUG: On Windows hosts, start_agent_in_docker writes task.md with broken file permissions — the file appears in /tmp but is inaccessible (mode shows as '?????????'). Root cause likely: Docker volume mount or temp file creation uses a Windows NTFS-incompatible path. Fix needed in Voltron: write task content via docker exec echo or heredoc rather than a mounted temp file. DOLT BUG: bd dolt push fails with 0xc0000142 (DLL not found) on Windows. Dolt binary has a Windows compatibility issue. Consider replacing with a different sync mechanism or a pre-built Windows-native Dolt binary. Both issues are blocking for Windows-based development workflows.
